description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for configuring and transforming Vite build setup within the Playwright component testing framework, including directory resolution, endpoint configuration, dynamic config creation, component population, and index file transformation.

methods.name: resolveDirs
methods.description: Resolves the directories for component templates, cache, and config based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the server endpoint configuration including host, port, and protocol based on the full config.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vite configuration object with custom settings, including support for JSX and framework plugins.

methods.name: populateComponentsFromTests
methods.description: Populates a component registry with imported component info from test data.

methods.name: hasJSComponents
methods.description: Checks if any components in the list are JavaScript components based on their import paths.

methods.name: transformIndexFile
methods.description: Transforms index files to automatically import React if needed and inject component import statements.

methods.name: frameworkConfig
methods.description: Retrieves framework-specific configuration from the full config object.
